name: MIMIC-IV-Ext-SDBench
description: MIMIC-IV-Ext-SDBench contains 488 case records derived from MIMIC-IV emergency department encounters in which the patient was subsequently admitted as an inpatient. Each case is formatted primarily for use with the Sequential Diagnosis Benchmark, an interactive diagnostic-reasoning benchmark in which an agent starts from a brief vignette and must request further information iteratively from a gatekeeper agent that mediates access to the underlying case record. Once an agent emits a diagnosis, a judge agent grades it against the ground truth. Each MIMIC-IV-Ext-SDBench case provides an initial diagnosis-free vignette, the de-identified discharge summary and the ground truth diagnosis sourced from MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2. The dataset is split into 163 train, 254 validation and 71 clinician-reviewed test cases. Beyond its use as a dataset for SDBench specifically, it can be used as a curated dataset for other sequential and non-sequential diagnostic reasoning tasks, evaluations, and benchmarks, with the clinician-reviewed test set providing expert-checked ground truth diagnoses.
